title: SPA fallback condition is always-true, making the final 404 branch unreachable
detail: api/routes.ts trailing 404 guards on `!startsWith('/api/')` but /api/ returns earlier, so the catch-all is dead code. Re-reported 10 runs, never fixed.

title: Path-prefix containment checks omit the trailing separator (path traversal)
detail: `startsWith(resolvedDir)` must append `path.sep` or siblings like `outputs-evil` bypass it. Recurs across gallery/caption/upload/config variants over 5 runs.

title: handleVerifyPython forwards raw err.message / Python stderr to the client
detail: api/config.ts returns the spawn exception message AND the last stderr line to the client (path/env disclosure). Both paths need fixing: catch block returns e.message; non-zero exit path exposes Python traceback last line. Log server-side, return generic. Re-flagged 11 runs.

title: handleKnowledgeAnalyze exposes internal error message (may include API-key detail)
detail: api/knowledge.ts forwards err.message from DeepSeek/third-party calls to the client. Return generic error, log full detail server-side. Re-flagged 7 runs.

title: killJob lacks a pid guard and finalizes before stream drain
detail: lib/subprocess.ts: guard `job.pid` before process.kill(); rely on proc.exited to finalize after streams drain rather than calling finalize() directly from killJob — the direct call broadcasts status before stdout/stderr buffers are flushed. Re-flagged 5 runs.

title: isPathAllowed() defaults to full REPO_DIR instead of narrow output dirs
detail: caption/upload accept arbitrary client paths but allow-scope is REPO_DIR, not OUTPUT_DIRS. Narrow to the minimum dir set (OUTPUT_DIRS + UPLOAD_DIR). The trailing-separator fix is already in place (line 38 uses d + path.sep), but the SCOPE is still the full repo. Re-flagged 6 runs.

title: clearJobs accepts arbitrary status without an allowlist (HTTP handler AND low-level manager)
detail: api/jobs.ts handleClearJobs casts `status` unchecked AND lib/subprocess.ts clearJobs(statuses) deletes matching jobs without restricting to CLEARABLE=['completed','failed']. Only the HTTP handler enforces the allowlist; any future internal caller (admin route, workflow script) invoking subprocessManager.clearJobs directly could pass ['running'] and silently kill+purge in-flight jobs (deleteJob also SIGTERMs running children). Validation must live at the trust boundary (the manager), not just the route. Clamp statuses inside clearJobs itself: filter to CLEARABLE before iterating. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: HTML shell and API responses ship without baseline security headers
detail: api/routes.ts serves HTML/health without X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff etc. Add headers on shell + API responses. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: WebSocket log replay sends a LogLine object where the frontend expects a string
detail: api/ws.ts onOpen must serialize buffered {text,stream} to a string `line`; useWebSocket.ts expects a string. Type mismatch corrupts replay. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: React custom hook (useFieldHistory) called inside .map() — Rules of Hooks violation
detail: frontend/components/CommandForm.tsx calls a hook per list item, breaking hook-ordering guarantees. Hoist the hook out of the loop. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: Gallery DELETE trusts client-supplied dirIdx/name without verifying the entry was listed
detail: api/gallery.ts: path-prefix containment is not membership verification. Re-check dirIdx/name against a server-side scan before deleting. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: Cross-module singletons (subprocessManager) used without a matching import
detail: Handlers use a process/global singleton but omit its import (api/selftest.ts used subprocessManager unimported — runtime NameError). Grep usage vs imports.

title: subprocess readStream drops partial lines spanning chunk boundaries
detail: lib/subprocess.ts readStream must carry a `pending` buffer across read() chunks and flush on close, else log lines split across reads vanish.

title: FTS5 'optimize' runs after _indexed=true, so a thrown optimize masks build failure
detail: lib/gallery-index.ts buildIndex sets `_indexed = true` (line 50) BEFORE running `INSERT INTO images_fts(images_fts) VALUES('optimize')` (line 51). If optimize throws (corrupt/large FTS5 index, OOM), the exception propagates but isIndexed() already returns true, so handleGallerySearch never retries the build — subsequent searches run against a half-built/under-optimized index and return empty/wrong results with no rebuild triggered. Wrap DELETE+insertAll+optimize in try/catch; set _indexed=true ONLY after full success, reset to false on failure. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: Bun.serve request.json() returns unknown — destructured without validation
detail: Handlers destructure body.dirIdx/body.name directly from `unknown`. Validate/cast before field access to avoid runtime type errors.

title: useLoras clears _fetching before setting _cache on the success path (cache race)
detail: frontend/hooks/useLoras.ts: ordering lets concurrent callers re-fetch. Set the cache before clearing the fetching flag.

title: useDefaultState lists serverDefaults object identity in deps, re-merging unnecessarily
detail: frontend/hooks/useDefaultState.ts: an object identity in a useEffect dep array triggers re-merge on every render. Depend on primitive fields instead.

title: handlePutConfig accepts arbitrary outputDir/modelsDir without path-containment validation
detail: api/config.ts write-time path is not bounded — a client can point generation at any directory. Validate against an allowlist at write time; reject absolute paths or traversal (..) that escape the allowed root. At minimum require they resolve within REPO_DIR or its sibling output store. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: CSRF/origin check compares against the request's own Host header (DNS-rebinding bypass)
detail: api/routes.ts and api/ws.ts: origin allowlist is derived from Host header — DNS-rebinding makes attacker origin match. Use a fixed allowlist: `new Set(['http://localhost:3099', 'http://127.0.0.1:3099'])`. Mirror in both HTTP routes and WS upgrade. Re-flagged 4 runs.

title: Upload/gallery serves files without Content-Type + nosniff (stored XSS via polyglot/SVG/HTML)
detail: api/gallery.ts + api/upload.ts: extension-only upload check + missing nosniff lets a polyglot payload execute. Sniff content and set headers.

title: Upload file-size check runs after the full multipart body is parsed into memory
detail: api/upload.ts: check Content-Length before req.formData() to fail-fast; post-parse check must remain as backstop (Content-Length can be spoofed). Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: File-path string fields passed to the subprocess skip path-containment checks
detail: lib/args.ts forwards path fields to run.py without containment; apply the same boundary as the API layer. (Distinct from the startsWith-separator bug.)

title: Persistent hotspots: api/routes.ts, api/config.ts, lib/subprocess.ts, api/gallery.ts, api/knowledge.ts, api/model-check.ts, api/models.ts, lib/knowledge-extractor.ts
detail: Across 12 runs these files attract the most findings. This run (2026-06-19T21): api/routes.ts=3, frontend/hooks/ui/useWebSocket.ts=2, api/gallery.ts=2, lib/knowledge-extractor.ts=2, api/config.ts=5, api/model-check.ts=2, api/models.ts=2, api/knowledge.ts=2, api/caption.ts=1, lib/paths.ts=1. Path-traversal/error-leak/flag-ordering/fetch-timeout classes keep regressing here.

title: All 12 runs were review-only (effort:low / review-only mode) — zero fixes applied, zero adversarial verdicts
detail: Never run at effort:medium+fix in this history, so recurring findings stayed unfixed. To close them run medium/high with fix:true (clean tree required).

title: Findings skew to security and correctness; other dims near zero
detail: This run (2026-06-19T21): security=14, correctness=4, error-handling=4 out of 22 total — 82% in security+correctness+error-handling. type-safety/code-quality continue near zero. Focus on security+correctness; sparse dims are low-yield.

title: Top recurring findings have FP-rate 0 — re-report them, do not suppress as noise
detail: Reflection: correctness/security avg_fp_rate=0 across 12 runs. SPA-404, path-traversal, error-leak, fetch-timeout, CSRF-rebinding, absolute-path-leak and validate-python-path findings are real, unfixed defects that re-surface.

title: job_failed WS message received but frontend never calls setOutputFiles for it
detail: frontend/hooks/ui/useWebSocket.ts: job_complete handler calls setOutputFiles but job_failed does not. The WS broadcast in api/ws.ts sends outputFiles for BOTH completed and failed jobs, so a job that fails mid-run carries already-produced outputs that the frontend silently discards. Fix: add `if (msg.outputFiles?.length) setOutputFiles(msg.outputFiles)` in the job_failed branch. Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: useCommandView substitutes WS logs over restored job logs even when job is not running
detail: frontend/hooks/commands/useCommandView.ts derivedJob uses WS `logs` when `logs.length > 0`, regardless of job.status. A restored completed/failed job can show stale WS logs from a prior subscription until subscribe() fires. Fix: gate the WS log substitution on `job.status === 'running' && logs.length > 0`. Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: WebSocket reconnect timer not cleared before setting new timer on close (double-reconnect risk)
detail: frontend/hooks/ui/useWebSocket.ts ws.onclose sets a new reconnect timer without clearing any pending prior timer. Multiple rapid close events queue multiple reconnect attempts; each creates a new WebSocket and the backoff resets incorrectly. Fix: `if (reconnectTimer.current) clearTimeout(reconnectTimer.current)` before the setTimeout in onclose. Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: Gallery DELETE companion-file cleanup uses only the verbatim base name, missing multi-segment suffixes
detail: api/gallery.ts handleGalleryDelete deletes `{base}.manifest.json` etc., but for relay/segment filenames like `output_seg01_relay`, the companion was found by findCompanionJson via progressive shortening (_relay/_seg01 stripping). The delete handler never strips these suffixes so orphaned .manifest.json/.run.json/.caption.json remain (which may contain prompt + params). Fix: reuse findCompanionJson(dir, base, suffix) per companion type, then tryDelete the resolved path (keeps delete symmetric with list). Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: validatePythonPath uses substring match for /.venv/ allowing arbitrary paths that contain the string
detail: api/config.ts `resolved.includes('/.venv/')` passes `/tmp/evil/.venv/bin/python` and `resolved.includes('/venv/')` passes `/home/attacker/venv/bin/malicious`. The malicious binary is then invoked by handleVerifyPython (Bun.spawnSync) and by caption/model-check via resolvePythonBin — an arbitrary-command-execution primitive via the config write endpoint. Should use prefix match against known project venv dirs (REPO_DIR/python/venv/ and REPO_DIR/ComfyUI/.venv/) with trailing path.sep. Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: callDeepSeek makes outbound fetch without an AbortSignal timeout (indefinite hang, request-slot exhaustion)
detail: lib/knowledge-extractor.ts callDeepSeek: no AbortSignal on the fetch to api.deepseek.com. A slow/stalled response holds the server request open indefinitely, exhausting request slots on the single Bun event loop. The function is awaited end-to-end through the HTTP handler so the client connection also hangs. Compare with vlm.ts which uses AbortSignal.timeout(5000). Fix: add `signal: AbortSignal.timeout(60_000)`, catch TimeoutError in handleKnowledgeAnalyze's existing try/catch. Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: Caption API forwards style/prompt to subprocess without allowlist or length cap
detail: api/caption.ts handleCaptionRun: `style` passed to run.py without enum check (valid: default/photography/t2i/profile/style/score/compare/review/playwright), and `prompt` has no length cap. Large prompts (up to 50MB body limit) forwarded verbatim to the VLM subprocess — DoS. style/prompt follow value-taking flags so argparse won't misparse as flags, but the lack of an allowlist/length cap is still an input-validation gap. The `image` positional is already guarded against leading-dash injection. Fix: allowlist style; cap prompt at ~4000 chars before spawning. Re-flagged 3 runs.

title: handleModelCheck returns raw run.py stderr to client (filesystem paths / tracebacks)
detail: api/model-check.ts: on non-JSON output the raw decoded stderr is returned directly as the `error` field (Response.json error: stderr). Python tracebacks carry absolute filesystem paths and env details over an unauthenticated localhost API. Sibling handlers (caption.ts, upload.ts) deliberately log stderr server-side and return a generic message — model-check is inconsistent and leaks. Same info-disclosure class as verify-python-leaks-stderr. handleModelCheckCache line 63 has the identical `e.message` pattern. Fix: console.error stderr server-side, return 'check-model failed — see server logs'. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: proc.stdout/stderr.getReader() runs outside the try/catch, leaving job stuck 'running'
detail: lib/subprocess.ts: proc.stdout/stderr are null-checked (line 143) inside the try/catch, but `proc.stdout.getReader()` / `proc.stderr.getReader()` on lines 210-211 run OUTSIDE that try/catch (which ends at line 133). If getReader() throws synchronously (a stream in an errored state), the exception propagates out of spawn(): finalize is never registered, the job stays status 'running' forever, the request handler crashes, and the orphaned job can never be finalized or cleanly killed. Fix: wrap the getReader() calls in the same finalize-as-failed guard used for the null-stream case (push stderr log, set status=failed, exitCode=-1, broadcastStatus, return id).

title: handleListLoras/handleListVaes expose absolute filesystem paths to unauthenticated clients
detail: api/models.ts: both model-listing endpoints return `path` as an absolute filesystem path (e.g. /Users/<user>/proj/.../python/mlx-movie-director/models/lora/<name>) for every LoRA/VAE entry. The frontend only needs the model name and relative identifiers (it builds CLI args via buildCliArgs which itself resolves and validates against allowed dirs). Leaking the full absolute path reveals the OS username and directory layout of the host. Combined with the lack of auth on the API, this is an unnecessary info-disclosure vector. Fix: return the model name/relative subfolder (e.g. path: entry.name) instead of the absolute path. Re-flagged 2 runs.

title: Before FLAGGING info-disclosure/error-handling/security issues, grep call-site usage + scan ~70 lines for an existing guard
detail: Mitigates the ~50% effort:low false-positive rate at flag-time (knowledge-level stand-in until the dimension prompts are edited - see gui-selfimprove:lever-review-dimensions-usage-aware). For each candidate: (1) grep the repo for callers/readers of the flagged symbol or endpoint; (2) scan ~70 lines around the site and the auth middleware for an existing guard or benign context (localhost dev tool, functional identity, upstream try/catch). If a guard exists or the context is benign, downgrade severity or drop the finding instead of emitting a context-free pattern match. Do NOT rely on the adversarial-verify gate to filter these - it reports upheld=0 yet leaves findings verified.
